what_this_is: DMRF N16 arm. The frozen source plus the full trained update, rescaled PER TENSOR so that each tensor's update Frobenius norm equals that of its rank-16 truncation. Matches the truncated arm's per-tensor norm profile while retaining every singular direction. FP32; never routed through BF16. No model was run to produce these bytes.
role: magnitude control for the rank-16 arm; isolates direction selection from magnitude reduction
formula: theta_supa + s_t * delta_t, s_t = ||P_r(delta_t)||_F / ||delta_t||_F per 2D tensor
nonmatrix_policy: 80 one-dimensional norm deltas kept in full (s_t = 1), as RANK-001 does
zero_denominator_policy: ||delta_t|| == 0 returns the source tensor and records scale 0.0
analysis_dtype: float64 for norms and scale factors; float32 stored
